metadata.description: Kanban's tracked Google marketplace, packaging the Google-side /solve and /autosolve workflows. Google-origin pull requests are reviewed by Codex only.

plugins.name: kanban
plugins.description: Kanban's Google-side workflow bundle: /solve claims and implements a GitHub issue through a google-origin pull request, and /autosolve drives Codex review of that pull request until approval. Never invokes Claude.
